raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
The combine coverage step patches [run] omit in .coveragerc to omit ModelUtils/Visualizer from the coverage calculation. However this runs after coverage combine already ran, so the omit has no effect on the collected data. 
The coverage report then reports ModelUtils/Visualizer at 0% coverage and fails on PR.s

Pass --omit flags directly to coverage xml and coverage report so skipped packages are excluded from the report regardless of when .coveragerc is patched.

raw_graphql_pull_request.title: Pass --omit to coverage report when suites are skipped

detail.body:
The combine coverage step patches [run] omit in .coveragerc to omit ModelUtils/Visualizer from the coverage calculation. However this runs after coverage combine already ran, so the omit has no effect on the collected data. 
The coverage report then reports ModelUtils/Visualizer at 0% coverage and fails on PR.s

Pass --omit flags directly to coverage xml and coverage report so skipped packages are excluded from the report regardless of when .coveragerc is patched.
detail.title: Pass --omit to coverage report when suites are skipped

files.patch:
@@ -496,28 +496,17 @@ jobs:
           python -m pip install --upgrade pip coverage
           python -m coverage combine coverage-data-*/.coverage
           # A skipped suite leaves its package at 0% and pulls the 95% gate
-          # down. Omit that package; a push still runs both suites.
-          python - << 'PY'
-          import os
-          from pathlib import Path
-          extra = []
-          if os.environ["MODELUTILS"] != "true":
-              extra.append("    TraceLens/ModelUtils/*")
-          if os.environ["VISUALIZER"] != "true":
-              extra.append("    TraceLens/Visualizer/*")
-          text = Path(".coveragerc").read_text()
-          if extra:
-              lines = text.splitlines()
-              out = []
-              for line in lines:
-                  out.append(line)
-                  if line.strip() == "omit =":
-                      out.extend(extra)
-              Path(".coveragerc").write_text("\n".join(out) + "\n")
-              print("omitting skipped packages:", ", ".join(item.strip() for item in extra))
-          PY
-          python -m coverage xml
-          python -m coverage report --fail-under=95
+          # down. Pass --omit so coverage report/xml exclude those files.
+          # A push still runs both suites so OMIT_FLAGS is empty.
+          OMIT_FLAGS=""
+          if [ "$MODELUTILS" != "true" ]; then
+            OMIT_FLAGS="$OMIT_FLAGS --omit=TraceLens/ModelUtils/*"
+          fi
+          if [ "$VISUALIZER" != "true" ]; then
+            OMIT_FLAGS="$OMIT_FLAGS --omit=TraceLens/Visualizer/*"
+          fi
+          python -m coverage xml $OMIT_FLAGS
+          python -m coverage report --fail-under=95 $OMIT_FLAGS
 
       - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
         if: success() && needs.select-pr-tests.outputs.mode == 'all'
